info.title: SendyKit API
info.description:
Canonical API contract for SendyKit v2.

Status tags on operations:
- x-status: live
- x-status: partial
- x-status: planned

Payment model:
- Stripe machine payments are the current machine-paid action mechanism.
- x402 compatibility is roadmap/future mode.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for send/enroll/trigger endpoints. 24h dedupe window.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

EmailQuery.name: email
EmailQuery.description: Email address filter or lookup target.

SinceQuery.name: since
SinceQuery.description: Relative duration or RFC3339 timestamp, depending on endpoint.

ReadinessEvaluateRequest.description: Canonical readiness evaluation input. Actual object can include operational, commercial, and environment signals.

PaymentRequired.description: Machine payment required for premium action
